Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Yep—sometimes, but it depends on whether the order has already been processed.

If your order is still unfulfilled, cancellation may be possible. Once it’s fulfilled or tracking has been added, it can’t be canceled anymore.

If you want, send me your order number or checkout email and I can help check what’s possible for your specific order 👀

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?

Usually, no—we can’t add items onto an order once it’s already been placed. Big mood, I know 😅

Best move is to place a separate order for the extra item. If your original order was just placed and you’d rather cancel it and reorder everything together, send me your order number or checkout email and I can check what’s possible.

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

If it’s already shipped, the address usually can’t be changed in transit. But it’s no biggie—our team can help with next steps and, if needed, get it reshipped to the correct address 🙂

If you want me to check your specific order, send your order number or checkout email and I’ll point you the right way.

You can usually update your contact/account details right in your MUD\WTR account portal 🙂

Here’s the scoop:

Log into your account on mudwtr.com
Go to your account settings/profile
Update things like your email, password, and saved info there
